title: IVG Smart Max Strawberry Raspberry Ice Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: The Strawberry Raspberry Ice IVG Smart Max Prefilled Pod brings together two bright berry flavours with a refreshing icy note. Sweet Strawberry combines with tangy Raspberry for a lively fruit mix, while a cool exhale adds a crisp, frosty finish. Each pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, paired with a 10ml refill reservoir that automatically replenishes the pod as you vape. Supporting up to 12,000 puffs depending on usage, this refill system avoids the need for messy refills or coil replacements. With mesh coil technology built in, the pod produces smooth vapour and delivers clear, consistent flavour. Made exclusively for use with the IVG Smart Max 12K Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, setup is quick and straightforward — just click the pod into place and vape. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill and press firmly until they click together. Insert the connected pod and refill into the Smart Max device.
